## Introducing simulation-based inference


## Simulating data

We have to have *roleR* loaded

```{r}
#| label: setup

library(roleR)

```

If this is a fresh install of *roleR* we need to setup *msprime* as well with `installMsprime()`.

Now we can sample parameter values a range of possible values (i.e. priors). Note that some parameter values might be fixed due to logical constraints on the data (e.g. number of basepairs or total species in the metacommunity).

```{r}
#| label: priors

n_prior_samp <- 2

param_samples <- data.frame(
    individuals_local = 1000, 
    individuals_meta = 100000, 
    species_meta = 300, 
    speciation_local = 0, 
    speciation_meta = 0.100,
    extinction_meta = 0.090, 
    dispersal_prob = runif(n_prior_samp, 0.001, 0.1), 
    env_optim = 0, 
    trait_sigma = runif(n_prior_samp, 0.001, 0.1), 
    env_sigma = runif(n_prior_samp, 0.1, 10), 
    comp_sigma = runif(n_prior_samp, 0.001, 10), 
    neut_delta = runif(n_prior_samp), 
    env_comp_delta = runif(n_prior_samp), 
    mutation_rate = 1e-09, 
    equilib_escape = 1, 
    alpha = 1e+04, 
    num_basepairs = 350, 
    init_type = "oceanic_island",
    niter = 50000,
    niterTimestep = 50000
)

param_samples <- lapply(1:nrow(param_samples), function(i) {
    as.list(param_samples[i, ]) |> 
        do.call(roleParams, args = _)
})
```

a function to generate these params (like for feeding into roleExperiment) should take, for each param, a single value, a range (in which case assumed uniform between end points), or a function defining a random generator; also a number of samples to draw


Now we can loop over parameter value combinations

```{r}
#| label: experiment
#| eval: false

funList <- list(
    hill_abund = hillAbund, 
    hill_gen = hillGenetic,
    hill_trait = hillTrait,
    richness = richness,
    mean_taj_D = meanTajD, 
    hill_taj_D = hillTajD, 
    cor_abund_pi = corAbundPi,
    cor_taj_D_abund = corTajDAbund,
    cor_taj_D_pi = corTajDPi
)


# this is actually run elsewhere
e <- roleExperiment(param_samples, funs = funList)
erun <- runRole(e, cores = 2)


```

```{r}
#| label: random-work
#| eval: false

# just messing with things to get them figured out

x <- proc.time()
r <- roleModel(param_samples[[i]]) |> 
    runRole()
proc.time() - x
i <- i + 1

boo <- getLocalComm(r)
a <- boo@spAbund

plot(sort(a[a > 0], TRUE), log = "y")

plot(boo@spAbund, boo@spGenDiv)
plot(boo@spAbund, boo@spTajD)
plot(boo@spTajD, boo@spGenDiv)

trt <- tapply(boo@indTrait, boo@indSpecies, mean)
plot(trt, a[as.numeric(names(trt))])

plot(sort(boo@indTrait, TRUE))

```


After running the RoLE experiment on a server, we can read-in the results

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

erun <- readRDS("../scratch/sbi_run/erun.rds")

res <- filter(erun@results, 
              generations > 0)


ggplot(res, aes(hill_abund_1, hill_gen_1)) +
    geom_hex() +
    scale_fill_viridis_c()

ggplot(res, aes(hill_abund_1, hill_taj_D_1)) +
    geom_hex() +
    scale_fill_viridis_c()

vars <- c("abund", "pi", "taj_D")
pat <- paste(vars, collapse = "|")

select(res, starts_with("cor_")) |> 
    pivot_longer(everything(), 
                 names_to = c("var1", "var2"),
                 names_pattern = paste0("cor_(", pat, ")_(", pat, ")"),
                 values_to = "corr") |> 
    as_tibble() |> 
    mutate(i = match(var1, vars),
           j = match(var2, vars),
           var1 = factor(vars[pmin(i, j)], levels = vars[-length(vars)]),
           var2 = factor(vars[pmax(i, j)], levels = vars[-1])) |> 
    ggplot(aes(corr)) +
    geom_histogram() +
    facet_grid(rows = vars(var2), cols = vars(var1))

ggplot(res, aes(dispersal_prob, hill_taj_D_1)) +
    geom_hex() +
    scale_fill_viridis_c()

ggplot(res, aes(dispersal_prob, hill_gen_1)) +
    geom_hex() +
    scale_fill_viridis_c()


ggplot(res, aes(trait_sigma, hill_gen_1)) +
    geom_hex() +
    scale_fill_viridis_c()


ggplot(res, aes(env_comp_delta, hill_trait_1)) +
    geom_hex() +
    scale_fill_viridis_c()

ggplot(res, aes(env_comp_delta, hill_gen_1)) +
    geom_hex() +
    scale_fill_viridis_c()

ggplot(res, aes(env_comp_delta, cor_abund_pi)) +
    geom_hex() +
    scale_fill_viridis_c()


res_complete <- filter(res, 
                       if_all(hill_abund_1:cor_taj_D_pi, is.finite))

pca <- select(res_complete, hill_abund_1:cor_taj_D_pi) |> 
    prcomp(center = TRUE)

pca_param <- select(res_complete, !(hill_abund_1:cor_taj_D_pi)) |> 
    cbind(pca$x)

ggplot(pca_param, aes(PC1, env_comp_delta)) +
    geom_point()
```
